name: RiftsMUD2
english_description: A real LPC mudlib on the DarkeLIB lineage (descended from the classic Nightmare/TMI mudlib family -- adm/obj/master.lpc credits 'mudlib.n and lil', author zortek@trekverse; a separate vestigial d/standard/adm/master.lpc credits Nightmare's Douglas Reay/'Pallando'), reskinned onto Palladium's post-apocalyptic Rifts tabletop RPG setting (MDC/SDC, OCCs, PPE). Not a duplicate of grav1tyzero/rifts-ds, a different Dead-Souls-lineage take on the same setting. Confirmed genuinely FluffOS/MudOS-compatible (zero driver_hook/H_[A-Z_]+ hits). Onboarding found and fixed 11 real programming bugs, three severe enough to have blocked ordinary play entirely: (1) AGENTS.md #7.118's filename-slice-arithmetic bug class in daemon/command.lpc's rehash() -- every command except quit/accept/decline silently returned the generic "What?" fail message from the very first boot; (2) AGENTS.md #8.20 (new) -- d/standard/setter.lpc's only path out of the character generator (the 'ready' command, add_action commented out) meant every new character was permanently trapped after picking a race/occupation, unable to ever enter the real game; (3) AGENTS.md #8.19 (new) -- adm/obj/login.lpc's new-password confirmation dialogue accepted/reported passwords incorrectly due to two missing return statements. Also fixed: a stray break/brace pair that broke the shared spell base class's compile; 9 stale /wizards/diewarzau/-> /std/diewarzau/ path references (the real content author's relocated personal directory) versus 4 confirmed-unarchived-content references left alone but guarded against the resulting new()-returns-0 crashes; an extra closing paren in a mapping literal; a backslash-line-continuation macro broken by interspersed blank lines in the ORIGINAL archive, plus a string/int return-type mismatch it was masking; AGENTS.md #6.7's REF_RESERVED_WORD collision in a real reachable wizard command; three independent bugs in another wizard command (object-vs-string type-check, two genuinely-undefined symbols replaced with the codebase's own real equivalent); and a genuinely-missing native efun (dump_socket_status) replaced with a minimal reimplementation using the real modern equivalent (socket_status). Full registration-to-gameplay playthrough verified live and repeatedly (character creation, look/score/inventory/who/say/help/quit all correct) after fixes. Admin account (fluffos/superuser rank) seeded via this lineage's own data-file mechanism (position field + data/db/groups.db, mirroring the archive's original admin, parnell). See libs/rifts2/NOTES.md and AGENTS.md #7.118/#8.19/#8.20 for the full writeup.
